# Shuuty

> Shuuty is a mobile application for turning ideas into action through voice-created tasks, immediate delegation, flexible groups, meetings, and nearby discovery.

Shuuty brings tasks, conversations, calendars, people, and places into one connected context. The public website is available in English and Polish. Shuuty is available for iOS and Android.

## Official pages

- [Shuuty — English](https://shuuty.com/): Product overview in English.
- [Shuuty — Polski](https://shuuty.com/pl/): Opis produktu w języku polskim.
- [Support](https://shuuty.com/support/): English support page.
- [Pomoc](https://shuuty.com/pl/support/): Polska strona pomocy.
- [Privacy Policy](https://shuuty.com/privacy/): Privacy information in English.
- [Polityka prywatności](https://shuuty.com/pl/privacy/): Informacje o prywatności po polsku.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://shuuty.com/terms/): Terms in English.
- [Regulamin](https://shuuty.com/pl/terms/): Regulamin w języku polskim.
